card.what: Open-body turnbuckle (rigging screw) for 3/16 in (5 mm) wire: jaw with a 1/4 in clevis pin on the chainplate, forged open body, swage stud crimped onto the shroud -- scored at the reference photo's setting (studs screwed in, 8 mm of thread showing each end: partloop/render_kw.py exposed=0.008)
card.boats: Catalina 22 shrouds (Tools/blender/build_fleet.py c22_hardware, on the kit Chainplate's Pin socket); the J/22 hero has its own closed-body turnbuckles in boots (Inputs/j22-hero/j22_mastgear.py)
card.distance: arm's reach on the side deck; the cockpit camera passes close when going forward
card.before: kit Turnbuckle from bk_parts.turnbuckle (Oct 2026): two thin bars between round bosses, ring studs, a plain fork below the pin

references.use: outline and proportions (Bean's hardware sheet, bottom row: open body, jaw, swage stud; square-on, set near closed)
references.url: project upload (Bean, Nov 8 2026: sailboat hardware reference sheet)
references.note: a retailer's product shot: measuring only, kept out of the repo; scored at the photo's setting (partloop/render_kw.py exposed=0.008), see turnbuckle_photo.json

references.use: forged open bodies on a dinghy's chainplates: window shape, centre bridge, cotter pins in the windows, studs
square-on and three-quarter open bodies, swage studs into the wire, toggles on deck plates
the same pair in place on the side deck (how far away the camera sees them)

references.note: Hayn 3/16 in jaw-to-swage: 1/4-28 thread, 1/4 in pin, closed 6-5/8 in (168 mm), open 9-3/8 in (238 mm), pin to swage end. Kit default 216 mm (the old part's wire end, about two thirds open)

sizes.name: Jaw's end to the swage's end, set near closed (168 mm closed length + the jaw's 9.5 mm)

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
